claims.disproof_condition: Downgrade if the product line disappears from Coherent's OCS/datacom portfolio or no design win is ever disclosed within two fiscal years; upgrade when any OCS maker or hyperscaler is named as a customer, or Coherent discloses collimator-array volumes/revenue.
claims.statement: Coherent productized a 2D Collimator Array for optical circuit switches (announced 2025-03-17, shown at OFC 2025): an optical assembly integrating a 2D lens array and a 2D fiber array — exactly the layer the Apollo paper defines as the Palomar OCS optical-path entrance. This makes Coherent the first named at-scale public supplier of this layer in the graph. Limits: product launch only, no named customer, no volume/revenue disclosure; PR retrieved via tier-3 carrier because primary wire pages were inaccessible.
